description: Export people to CSV. Export matching people as a CSV file. Returns signed download URLs. Limited to 1,000,000 records per export. Pass limit to export only the first N matching records. The request is synchronous — the response is returned once the export is complete (typically up to 30 seconds). Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

active_phones_only.description: Only include phone numbers with active reported phone activity. Numbers with inactive or unknown activity are excluded.

anchor.description: Controls the export anchor type. "person" exports one row per person (default). "phone" or "email" exports one row per phone/email.

bigquery_data_environment.description: Query Builder BigQuery dataset environment: 1 production, 2 staging, 3 development.

anyOf.description: Query Builder list protocol object. For people, use people_list_ids with numeric list IDs.
Query Builder export exclusion protocol. Pass true to exclude previously exported people, or pass a full exclude_previously_exported object.

fields.description: Field IDs to include in the export. Omit for the default set. Use person_coordinates to add separate person_latitude and person_longitude columns.

filters.description: Array of filters to apply. Omit or pass an empty array to export with no filters.

filter_id.description: Filter identifier (use GET /v1/filters to discover available filters)

operator.description: Comparison operator. Optional for BOOLEAN filters (automatically defaults to is_boolean).

anyOf.description: Filter value (shape depends on filter type and operator)
Query Builder list protocol object. For people, use people_list_ids with numeric list IDs.

landline_only.description: Only include landline phone numbers. Cannot be combined with mobile_only.

limit.description: Maximum file rows for a filter-based export, from 1 to 1,000,000. For person, phone or email output with chargeable property fields, property credits are scoped to the limited contact-row selection.

locations.description: Array of locations defining where to export. Required unless people_ids is provided.

code.description: Location code. Use a state abbreviation, county FIPS, city place ID or exact "City, ST" name, or 5-digit ZIP.

coordinates.description: Array of [longitude, latitude] coordinate pairs for polygon locations. Minimum 3 points.

east.description: East longitude of the bounding box (for bounds locations)

name.description: Exact city name when a city place ID is unknown.

north.description: North latitude of the bounding box (for bounds locations)

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles for radius locations

south.description: South latitude of the bounding box (for bounds locations)

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation used to disambiguate a city name.

west.description: West longitude of the bounding box (for bounds locations)

mobile_only.description: Only include wireless phone numbers. Cannot be combined with landline_only.

people_ids.description: Array of DealMachine person IDs to export (e.g., ["per_12345"]). Max 1000. When provided, locations become optional.

property_match.description: Defines the person-to-property relationship for the export.

require_email.description: Only include records where the contact has an email address.

require_phone.description: Only include records where the contact has a phone number.

scrub_dnc.description: Exclude contacts on the Do Not Call registry.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_people_export
